# Accessibility Checklist: Launch the new doncoleman.ca

**Purpose**: Validate that WCAG 2.2 AA requirements are specified and testable for the launch, including the content Don replaces and the error states and docs this slice adds
**Created**: 2026-09-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command. It tests requirement quality, not implementation.

## Coverage of the Standard

- [x] CHK001 Does the spec state that WCAG 2.2 AA (Constitution Principle X) applies to this slice, including pages whose copy Don replaces before launch? [Gap, Constitution §X]
- [x] CHK002 Is a requirement defined that the replacement Services, Speaking and Focus Pocus content passes the same automated accessibility checks as the placeholder content? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003a]
- [x] CHK003 Is it stated whether a failing accessibility run is a readiness item that blocks the switch? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK004 Is the claim that no markup changes occur beyond meta tags traceable to a requirement, with an a11y regression expectation if the claim proves false? [Assumption, Plan §Constitution Check X]
- [x] CHK005 Are the page templates covered by automated accessibility checks enumerated, including the not-found page that Ghost-only addresses will now reach? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019]

## Not-Found and Error Experience

- [x] CHK006 Are requirements for the not-found page specified for readers arriving from old inbound links (clear message, route to home or posts, keyboard reachable)? [Gap, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK007 Is a contrast requirement stated for the not-found page and any new error or status messaging? [Gap]
- [x] CHK008 Is the heading and landmark structure of the not-found page specified so it is navigable with assistive technology? [Gap]

## Contact Form (live-domain exposure)

- [x] CHK009 Are accessibility requirements for the contact form's error, success and rate-limited states specified (labels, error association, status announcements, focus management)? [Coverage, Gap] (n/a: contact form states are unchanged by this feature; their accessibility requirements belong to the contact feature spec and its checks stay in the gate (spec Assumptions))
- [x] CHK010 Is the Turnstile widget's accessibility requirement stated, including a non-visual path and behaviour when it fails to load? [Gap, Edge Case] (n/a: the Turnstile widget is unchanged by this feature and specified in the contact feature spec (spec Assumptions))
- [x] CHK011 Is accessible behaviour for the contact form defined with JavaScript disabled, consistent with Principle V? [Consistency, Constitution §V] (n/a: no-JavaScript behaviour of the contact form is unchanged by this feature and specified in the contact feature spec (spec Assumptions))
- [x] CHK012 Are the WCAG 2.2 criteria new at AA (target size minimum, focus not obscured, accessible authentication) explicitly assessed for the form and navigation? [Coverage, Gap] (n/a: no form or navigation component changes in this feature; WCAG 2.2 AA criteria were assessed in the features that built them and their axe wcag22aa checks stay in the gate (FR-027))

## Redirect and Navigation

- [x] CHK013 Is the `www` to apex redirect specified so assistive technology and keyboard users meet no certificate error, interstitial or loop? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010a]
- [x] CHK014 Are language, title and landmark requirements stated for pages whose canonical and origin change, so metadata changes do not alter page titles or document language? [Gap]
- [x] CHK015 Are link text and purpose requirements defined for the internal links the crawler validates, so broken-link fixes do not introduce non-descriptive links? [Gap]

## Documentation and Walkthrough Accessibility

- [x] CHK016 Is the plain-language requirement (Constitution Development Workflow) applied to the walkthrough, the "Problem:" summaries and the setup check output? [Consistency, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK017 Must the setup check's waiting, pending, complete and problem states be distinguishable without relying on colour or symbols alone? [Gap, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK018 Is it stated whether `docs/` content is published, so the accessibility scope of the walkthrough is explicit? [Assumption]

## Measurability and Non-Functional

- [x] CHK019 Are Core Web Vitals and performance budget expectations stated as unchanged on the live domain, including the Web Analytics change on the apex? [Consistency, Constitution §X]
- [x] CHK020 Is it specified that the analytics added on the apex is privacy-focused and adds no third-party script beyond what Principle X allows? [Dependency, Constitution §X]
- [x] CHK021 Can the accessibility acceptance criteria be objectively verified (named tool, rule set, threshold such as zero serious or critical violations) rather than "meets WCAG"? [Measurability, Gap]
- [x] CHK022 Is a manual accessibility review (keyboard, screen reader, reflow at 320 CSS px) required for the replaced content, or explicitly excluded with rationale? [Coverage, Gap]
